_comment: Licences Inkpact (AGPL-3.0) may depend on, checked by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (pnpm check:licenses). An OR expression passes when one side is allowed, AND when both are. A package without an SPDX expression gets an entry under `packages`, keyed `npm:<name>` or `nuget:<id>`, with the licence it really has and the reason. Add to `allowed` only after checking the licence is compatible with AGPL-3.0.

nuget:xunit.abstractions.reason: The nuspec has only a licence URL (the Apache-2.0 text in the xunit repository).
